title: Structure engineering footer
description: A paper footer edge to edge: a mono uppercase copyright and acknowledgement row, four ruled link columns (bold sans heading over mono links separated by hairlines, one link set as an ink box), then a giant tight wordmark across the bottom with a small credit at the far right. On phones the links come first and the small print last. The columns rise 48px one after another as they come into view.
notes: the wordmark is plain text in the display face, sized to the window on phones and 248px at desktop
